module: GE extension `core_vehicle_vehicleTriggerHighlight`: highlights vehicle triggers (interaction zones defined in the jbeam) in the 3D world. Every frame, onUpdate draws with debugDrawer a sphere (with a camera-facing circle) or a pulsing box (oscillating alpha) and, if requested, a label 'id - name [section]'. Useful for trigger debug/editing tools.
notes: Identifiers are stored as strings; `triggerId` is the trigger's cid (key of vdata.triggers and argument of veh:getTrigger).
Per-trigger options: showTriggerIdAsLabel (true by default; false hides the label).

The trigger is determined to be a sphere if trg.type == 'sphere' (or type absent and size a number) and a box if trg.type == 'box' (or type absent and size a table); sphere radius = size, otherwise radius, otherwise half the diagonal of size, otherwise 0.1.
drawOneHighlightedTrigger modifies the shared color SPHERE_COLOR (alpha field) on each draw: triggers drawn in the same frame share the same color.
Labels use debugDrawer:drawTextAdvanced; boxes are drawn as filled triangles + edges.

hasHighlightedTriggers.desc: Indicates whether at least one trigger is highlighted.

isHighlightedTrigger.desc: Indicates whether a given trigger is highlighted.

setHighlightedTrigger.desc: Adds a trigger to the highlight (does not clear the others).

setHighlightedTriggerByName.desc: Like setHighlightedTrigger but finds the trigger by its name, its jbeam id or its cid in the vehicle's vdata.triggers.

returns.desc: false if the trigger is not found

unhighlightTrigger.desc: Removes a trigger from the highlight.

clearHighlightedTrigger.desc: Removes all highlights from all vehicles.

getSerializedHighlightedTriggerData.desc: Exports the highlights as a serializable list.

setSerializedHighlightedTriggerData.desc: Replaces all highlights with those of the given list (getSerialized... format). Also accepts the legacy format of a single {vehId, triggerId} tuple.

onUpdate.desc: Per-frame hook: draws each highlighted trigger (sphere or pulsing box, label).

dt.desc: elapsed time (s), used to pulse the alpha
